free_text: The guideline criterion dictates deferral because the mpMRI showed a PI-RADS 2, which falls into the deferral range. Although the PSA velocity was rising (0.31 ng/mL/yr) and the csPCa probability was high (0.66), the retrieved radiology report explicitly stated 'No PI-RADS 3 or higher lesion identified.' This finding, combined with the PI-RADS 2 score, overrides the clinical suspicion for immediate biopsy.
